notes.title: Out Now! Improvements of the PC Version of Ultra Age
notes.notes:
Heads up! Ultra Age is out now on Steam! Experience this definitive version of the game with the following improvements over its 2021 release on consoles!

[u][b]Improved Graphics, Stable FPS Experience[/b][/u]
Ultra Age uses Unreal Engine 4 to express a realistic future world and environment, giving gamers a strong sense of immersion. The PC version improves the overall appearance quality of background and chapter graphics. Some sections have incorporated lighting and post-processing effects. 
In addition, the appearance of the main character 'Age' has been revamped and improved. 
FPS remains stable for 60 frames, even in various environments in the game. We also added graphic and frame options for a variety of PC environments.

[u][b]Play More Comfortably[/b][/u]
Ultra Age allows you to flow through many combos in fast, stylish actions with numerous blades. We've refined the difficulty system to allow more gamers to play at ease and have improved the level design. We've also added save points and energy crystals for more recovery opportunities.

[u][b]Completely New Voiceovers[/b][/u]
For the release of the PC version, we have completely re-recorded all English and Japanese voices in the game. With this new, more realistic dialogue, we hope gamers can have an even more immersive experience.

*Please note the above improvements are planned to be implemented into console versions eventually as well.
